response.justification: Candidate is a strong, versatile senior/staff-level individual contributor with broad full-stack, distributed-systems, and open-source experience, but the resume shows no executive leadership track record, no history scaling engineering orgs from 10 to 30+, no production multi-agent AI system ownership, and no fintech credit-risk or regulated-environment experience — all hard requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Broad technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Some exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators) at current role
Strong software craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source leadership, teaching/mentoring
concerns: No evidence of executive or senior leadership roles managing teams, budgets, or board communication
No demonstrated experience scaling engineering organizations (10→30+) or building leadership layers
No fintech credit-risk, working-capital, or regulated financial systems experience; AI-agent work is infrastructure/tooling, not production multi-agent decisioning systems

key_factors.factor: No production multi-agent AI or fintech-risk system ownership
Strong individual technical breadth and craftsmanship
